meta: Plan a whole week of meals with AI and shop just once: no more asking "what's for dinner?" every afternoon.

muc.title: What's for dinner?
muc.text: The hardest question every afternoon is what to cook. AI can plan the whole week's menu in one go.

muc.title: Tell AI about your household
muc.text: Tell AI how many people eat, your weekly budget, what anyone avoids and how much time you have to cook each night.

muc.title: One combined list
muc.text: Ask AI to combine the week's ingredients into one list grouped by meat and fish, vegetables and dry goods.

muc.title: Balanced meals
muc.text: Ask AI to balance vegetables, protein and carbs. If someone has a condition like diabetes, ask a dietitian.

muc.title: Next week's menu
muc.text: Ask AI for next week's dinner menu within your family's budget, with a shopping list.
